candidates.hook: Barn doors violently burst open as Prudence screams, 'Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!'
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana rushes to Toby's side, finds him burning hot and wheezing, and urgently demands boiling water to attempt an unproven remedy.
candidates.why: Opens on an immediate life-or-death crisis and ends at the peak of medical panic right before treatment begins.

candidates.hook: Prudence cries out in outrage: 'He shut the door in my face because we have no silver! The manor doctor laughed!'
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana directs hot herbal steam into the choking child's face, cutting right before we learn if he survives or suffocates.
candidates.why: Taps into strong class-divide outrage in the hook and cuts on the critical medical suspense beat before the resolution.

moments.desc: Barn doors slam open as a frantic village girl begs Juliana to save her dying little brother.
Prudence reveals the callous manor doctor refused to treat a dying child because they had no silver.
Prudence ominously reveals the Dowager Duchess is secretly dying of a mysterious illness inside the manor.
